messages:
priya: Quick summary from today's quant bakeoff for new-7B bring-up. Ran FP8, INT8 (GPTQ), and AWQ-8 across hosted/dedicated/private smoke matrices. Headline: AWQ gives best cost/latency tradeoff for hosted with ~38% token cost saving vs fp16, p95 latency +5ms, eval delta -0.45% overall. GPTQ-8 is slightly better on accuracy (-0.15%) but higher memory variance. FP8 shows best p95 (-8ms) but has a larger accuracy hit (~-0.6) on our safety/legal subsets.

mike: solid. can you drop the raw numbers and the golden-set diffs here? also any outlier failures? @jordan fyi for dashboarding.

priya: numbers (summary):
- AWQ-8: cost -38%, p95 +5ms, avg acc delta -0.45%, legal-subset -0.6%, hallucination rate +0.1%
- GPTQ-8: cost -33%, p95 +12ms, avg acc delta -0.15%, legal-subset -0.2%, memory spikes observed on 3090 workloads
- FP8: cost -42%, p95 -8ms, avg acc delta -0.6%, legal-subset -1.2% (regression alert)
No catastrophic failures, but FP8 triggered ~10 failing examples in the goldens (mostly long-context legal prompts).

sara: thanks. my read: AWQ is the house favorite for hosted canary. GPTQ could be a dedicated-only option. FP8 should be blocked for hosted until we fix the legal-subset regressions.

jordan: propose rollout gating:
- Hosted: AWQ canary 1% x 24h -> 5% x 24h -> 25% -> 100%; monitor eval delta, golden-set pass rate, p95, error-rate
- Dedicated: start with GPTQ at 5% for 48h then 25% if mem OK; AWQ optional
- Private: never auto-rollout; require customer opt-in and per-customer golden checks
Add automatic fallback to fp16 if: eval_delta <= -1.0% OR golden failures > 0.5% OR p95 > +20%.

owen: +1. I'd also add a short smoke matrix to run before any canary:
- smoke: 50 golden prompts (mix prod/top-10 and known hard legal), throughput stress (2x expected qps), p95 latency, kv-cache correctness
- acceptance criteria: golden accuracy delta > -0.5% (per-segment), no more than 2 failing examples on legal subset

priya: agreed. here's a draft of the rollout config we can commit to infra:
```
model_variants:
  - id: new-7b-awq
    canary_schedule: [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 1.0]
    monitors:
      - metric: golden_acc_delta
        threshold: -0.5
      - metric: p95_latency_pct
        threshold: 20
    fallback: new-7b-fp16
  - id: new-7b-gptq
    canary_schedule: [0.05, 0.25, 1.0]
    targets: [dedicated]
```

mike: perfect. infra notes: make sure KV-cache mismatch detection is enabled for AWQ (we saw a subtle tokenization/caching edge in earlier runs). @infra-bot can you add cache checks to the smoke pipeline?

infra-bot: noted. adding KV-cache checksum and mismatch alert to smoke stage. will post pipeline link when ready.

eval-bot: quick eval summary after today's rerun on extended goldens:
- AWQ: overall delta -0.48%, legal -0.62%, hallucination +0.09%
- GPTQ: overall -0.17%, legal -0.25%
- FP8: overall -0.71%, legal -1.35% (blocked)

sara: based on eval-bot, AWQ still within our soft gate (-0.5% overall is borderline) but legal subset is slightly over. proposal: run a 48h hosted AWQ canary at 0.5% with tightened golden-set (add 200 more legal prompts) and block FP8 from hosted until legal regression is fixed.

priya: +1. i'll create the canary and push the pipeline. action items:
- mike: prepare rollback script and traffic-split hooks (due EOD)
- jordan: prebuild dashboard panels and golden-set monitors (due tomorrow)
- owen: extend smoke matrix with the 200 additional legal prompts (due tomorrow)
- infra-bot: add KV-cache checks and smoke pipeline link

mike: will do. rollback rule: immediate 100% redirect to new-7b-fp16 if golden failures > 0.5% in any 10m window OR eval_delta <= -1.0%.

jordan: dashboard plan includes per-segment golden-failure trend, per-variant p95, memory cadence for dedicated nodes, and top 10 failing prompts for human review.

owen: i will also run a small long-context sweep overnight (8k tokens) to catch FP8/AWQ long-context regressions.

priya: thanks everyone. i'll post the canary thread once infra link is up. :rocket:

infra-bot: smoke pipeline created: https://ci.internal/repo/pipelines/quant-smoke/1894567890

mike: ack. incoming PR for rollout config and rollback scripts.

sara: nice. let's revisit after 48h canary data. :eyes:
